group: Property node present - walk disabled, simple validator

group: Property node present - complex validator handling

input.value: mock ExecutionContext with CollectorContext containing ValidatorState {complexValidator=true, walkEnabled=false, validationEnabled=true, matchedNode initially false}

cases.expected: Set containing ValidationMessage(s) from child validation. After validation, ValidatorState.matchedNode should be true (set before and after the recursive call). The original complex flag (true) must be restored.
cases.description: Tests the logic that marks the node as matched before and after validation when the parent validator is complex (e.g., oneOf).

group: Property node absent - required validator returns no errors

cases.expected: Empty Set (no required errors). The parent schema must have a RequiredValidator that returns an empty set.
cases.description: Validates that when a property is missing but the required validator reports no errors, the validator returns an empty error set.

group: Property node absent - required validator returns errors, non‑complex validator

cases.expected: Set containing the required ValidationMessage(s) (e.g., ["'mandatory' is required"]). Since the validator is not complex, errors are added to the result set.
cases.description: Ensures that missing mandatory properties generate required‑validation errors when the validator is not part of a complex construct.

group: Property node absent - required validator returns errors, complex validator

cases.expected: Empty Set (method returns early). ValidatorState.matchedNode should be set to false before returning.

group: Property node present - walk enabled with validation errors from walkSchema

group: Multiple properties - mixed present and absent with required validator

input.value: mock ExecutionContext with CollectorContext containing ValidatorState (complexValidator=false, walkEnabled=false, validationEnabled=true)

cases.expected: Set containing two ValidationMessages: "presentError" (produced by the child schema for "presentProp") and "'missingProp' is required" (produced by the parent RequiredValidator for the absent property). The evaluatedProperties set should contain "#/presentProp" only.
cases.description: Validates that the validator correctly processes several entries: it validates the existing property, adds its error, and for the missing property it invokes the RequiredValidator, adding its error to the final set.

group: Property node present - walk disabled, non‑complex validator, matchedNode unchanged
